mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_stage WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY stage_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_stage (script_id, stage_name, stage_description, stage_order, unlock_rule, timeout_minutes) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{stageName}, #{stageDescription}, #{stageOrder}, #{unlockRule}, #{timeoutMinutes})
mapper.update: UPDATE script_stage SET stage_name = #{stageName}, stage_description = #{stageDescription}, stage_order = #{stageOrder}, unlock_rule = #{unlockRule}, timeout_minutes = #{timeoutMinutes} WHERE id = #{id}
